notes: FleetComm 1.4 — the stress-test batch. FIRST-LAUNCH GARBLE: voice can no longer play over itself — when the app falls behind, it drops a syllable instead of stacking audio, and the COMM LOG now records when the machine is starving the audio engine (if the first launch ever sounds smeared again, that line is what to paste). NEW TOUR for new operators: sign in, pick a channel, set your talk key, talk, the overlay — five short steps that do the setup with you; replay it under SETTINGS ▸ HELP. HELMET CAMS: feeds follow a streamer through a reconnect instead of vanishing; a dead link retries on its own; POP OUT replaces PIP — every feed can float over the game in its own window with the burn-in and scanlines, as many as you want. The app no longer goes stale behind the game (cam feeds and the overlay kept updating only when you tabbed back). LSN ALL no longer echoes your own transmission back to you. SYS is now SETTINGS. ACCOUNTS & ACCESS has a search box and an ELEMENT LEAD button.
